steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan.

Whisk flour, sugar, baking soda, and salt together in a medium bowl. Stir egg, mayonnaise, bananas, and vanilla extract together in a large bowl until well combined. Stir flour mixture into banana mixture until no dry lumps remain. Pour batter into the prepared loaf pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 45 minutes. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes before removing to cool completely on a wire rack.

raw_recipe.headline: Low-Fat Banana Bread
raw_recipe.description: Light mayonnaise is the secret ingredient in this moist and delicious low-fat banana bread. Experiment by adding fruit, nuts, or chocolate chips!

video.description: A fluffy, soft, and flaky delight to have with breakfast. Spread on jam, butter, honey, (or all three!) for a tasty addition to many meals.

review.reviewBody: I wasn't sure about the mayo in this, but it turned out great! The end result is a moist, delicious banana bread that doesn't have as many calories and fat grams as most recipes but just as much taste. I am definitely keeping this recipe for future use!

Delicious and moist and easy and fast to throw together. I added 1/3 cup chocolate chips to the batter. It did take longer than 45 minutes to bake, so I closed off the oven and let it sit in there for an additional 5 minutes and it was perfect.

It's a daily thing at my house. breakfast for my son, a healthy evening snack for me. I use Splenda instead of sugar and whole wheat flour ,add toasted pecans or walnuts or dried blueberries or whatever I have on hand! If you don't have overripe bananas you can "cook" them to get them ready! Google it!

I only had 2 bananas but I forged ahead anyway. It came out fine. I used King Arthur whole wheat flour, half the sugar and threw in some baking powder. I made it into cupcakes, and it made exactly 12. On top of 6 of them, I put a very small half square of white chocolate, and smeared it around when it softened. Just made a thin film on the top. Tasted great!!!
I made a couple of changes - 4 bananas, 3/4 c sugar, 1/3 c mayo and 1 tsp baking powder. TURNED OUT GREAT!!!

I used quinoa flour instead of white flour. I had to add about 25 minutes to the baking time. This is a very moist, delicious recipe that was just a bit too sweet for me. Next time I will cut the sugar in half.

Excellent recipe. Couldn't help to tweak this to make it healthier as I am trying to reduce cal and fat where I can. This is a great base recipe and very easy to make. VERY!!!
Changes:
Flour: 1/2 cup wholemeal flour and 1 cup white. Will try all wholemeal next time.
Only had 2 Bananas so added: 61g Brambly Apple Sauce 
Added 93g Blueberries (had some left over from some muffins and wanted to use them up)
Added 2.5 tsp of cinnamon - will add more the next time as I LOVE cinnamon
Only used 1/2 cup (110g) of light brown muscovado sugar and no white. I thought it was sweet enough with the added fruit. I love sugar and sweet things but this is a healthier option. When using brown you dont need to use as much sugar.
I dusted the greased pan with flour and cinnamon :)
Used soured cream instead of mayo as it was expiring soon and wanted to use it up.
The smell throughout the house was divine and couldn't help braking a small piece off when it was cooling on the wrack.
RECOMMEND RECOMMEND RECOMMEND happy baking

I took another reviewer's suggestion and used half light mayo and half applesauce. Also used 4 very ripe medium sized bananas. When making banana things I like to blend them in the blender with the other wet ingredients--I did that here, too. Subbed 1/2 cup bread flour and also added 2 tbl oat bran. Cut sugar down to 3/4 cup and added 1/3 cup chocolate chips on top of the batter when it was in the pan so they wouldn't sink to the bottom. The choc chips make it so sweet I could even cut the sugar down more next time. It took 50 minutes to bake and even then it was very moist and the texture is a little gummy but not that noticeable. However, the flavor is great and my family liked this a lot.

I will make this again.

I'm sure the original recipe is great but I had to cut out the sugar and added 1 tsp of stevia and 1/3 cup unsweetened applesauce for this recipe. My daughter is on a low fat/low sugar diet because she was only born with half of her pancreas. My Bonnie LOVES her banana bread and until yesterday, she hasn't had it for years! Applesauce and stevia is a great substution if you or a loved one happens to be a diabetic of have a rare health disorder.

This was sooo good it was hard not to eat more than 1 serving. Even my husband ate it with all the mmm ahhh yumm noises. I only had white flour so thats what i used, although next time i will have whole wheat, and instead of a cup of white sugar i used 1/2 cup of brown sugar and 1/2 cup of splenda. I only had two bananas so i did add about 1/2 cup of no sugar added applesauce. I also used plain unsweetened greek yogurt instead of mayo, even though i have the light stuff, it gave it a little protien and got rid of any extra fat, calories, sodium, and even cut back on the carbs. I also was a little leary off the "tang" of the mayo. I added 2 oz. of crushed up walnuts too. Cooked for a little longer to but my oven is difficult. Overall very moist, and unrecognizable as "diet".

I made some adjustments to the ingredients because I have to do low fat and low sugar being a Pancreatic Cancer survivor with an altered digestive system. 
Here are my adaptations:

-1/3 cup of maple syrup instead of white sugar 

-King Arthur gluten-free All purpose baking mix instead of all purpose flour

- 1/4 cup fat-free Greek yogurt and 1/4 cup of the light mayonnaise

 I also used large bananas which made this really moist and still light

It turned delicious. I will definitely make this on a regular basis.
I added a cup of walnuts..I love this easy recipe
50 minutes cooking time was perfect. Great recipe.
Awesome recipe I added 1 cup blueberries (frozen) came out great

Awesome bread . First time I made it I just did the recipe except I did half mayonnaise and half yogurt. This time I did half the sugar substituted yogurt for the mayonnaise and added a1/4 c of pineapple and 1/4 c of chocolate chips

Great bread. I cut the mayo in half and added enough applesauce to equal the 1/2 cup total, and cut the sugar by a bit because of the sweetness of the applesauce. Delicious--I am always looking for a dairy free recipe.

This is a tasty, moist banana bread that we really enjoyed. I added 1 cup of walnuts and used 3 bananas. Next time I will add 5 minutes to the baking time. The calorie count is lower than many recipes, but nothing is sacrificed. I highly recommend it.
This is the only banana bread recipe I use. I add chocolate chips and pecans . It is simply the best.
Super easy - I added less than the required cup of sugar I added 3/4 and chopped walnuts on top. It tasted excellent.
I make this every month just to keep my love for the Banana Breads variety of other ingredients i can put in.
